reviews.title: The new ownership ruined it
reviews.text:
I used to really enjoy and rely on this app, I would recommend to anyone. But since the update and ownership change this app sucks. The interface changes are Atrocious, the tracking is in accurate. I will be looking for a new app and canceling this subscription.

Update 8/11/2026:

The radar feature changing the way that the cells are read or appear don’t look as clean and even yesterday during a storm your app appear that the cell wasn’t as big as other radars anticipated and we got Slammed.

The projected weather breakdown of each hour with the results on the right and not the graph is now confusing. Yes you have the graph for the current day but no future day.

reviews.title: Absolutely appalling
reviews.text: People don’t pay for something you already pay for with your taxes! I have used this app for years and now it will get deleted. I refuse to pay for a service my taxes already pay for. I get having a subscription for extras such as forecasts and things, but charging a subscription fee for public safety!! NOAA is a government agency, taxes pay for it… this app even says “NOAA network” we already pay for it!!! Shame on you.

reviews.title: Changes to app
reviews.text: A few months ago I would have given this  5 stars. Have used it several years. NOW with all the changes it is just like the majority of weather apps- it tells you “what to think”.  I found the straight data useful instead of this “I will analyze for you”.  This analysis  gives me “answers” without knowing my question. Now looking for another app and will not renew my subscription.  Plus, half the time the radar screen shows up as just black.

reviews.title: Ora downgrade
reviews.text: NOAA was great.  Now that it’s Ora, functionality and details are awful.  Will cancel and look for another weather app.

reviews.title: Useless to search other cities now
reviews.text: It’s almost useless to search other cities I’m traveling to now because the search only searches “City name, United States” ignoring that there are multiple within the country in different states. There is no way to narrow it down within the country by adding the state apparently and it doesn’t list them in the search listing. Incredibly annoying and poor user experience. I can’t look at the forecast for my travels easily anymore. I will be uninstalling.

reviews.title: WARNING: ORA RIP OFF
reviews.text: Do NOT press “Skip” when new app opens - it automatically enrolls you in the “Free Trial” and there is NO WAY TO CANCEL in the app. Free trial does not show up in iPhone “Subscriptions”. I did the update of the old app and thought I’d at least look it over despite the several comments about the old version costing way too much and charging for free NOAA info that other apps gave for less or for free. I thought they might be under new ownership that wasn’t as greedy. The splash page took a long time to load. After it did, the first page offered a tour of new features and a “Skip” tour at the bottom. I pressed “Skip” and the next thing I know it’s telling me I’ve accepted the free trial. NOT!!! Went everywhere I could trying to find a Cancel Free Trial button but there’s nothing anywhere in the app for that. Yet it doesn’t show up in Apple Subscriptions to cancel. Can’t believe Apple allows this shabby kind of trick rip-off. You can’t even contact Apple about it. Where? How? Considering a formal FCC complaint.
